author: hubitrep (original by David Gutheinz)
releaseNotes: Websocket handling reworked: keys wait for the TV's confirmation, one connection per burst, no stale keys after a reboot or a failed power-off. Power state without PowerState waits for the TV to confirm. Presets and art mode no longer pause the driver. SmartThings commands are async and an expired key is reported once. Full list in the README.
